remarks: Bright and spacious one-bedroom condo with a private balcony, ideally located on Glenbrook Road-just minutes from vibrant Downtown Stamford, Metro-North, and I-95 for an easy commute. This beautifully renovated home features a brand-new kitchen with modern cabinetry, quartz countertops, updated appliances, and stylish new flooring throughout. Freshly painted, the unit also boasts a completely redesigned bathroom with a window for natural light and ventilation. The open-concept layout offers comfortable living and dining space, perfect for everyday living or entertaining. The generously sized bedroom includes two windows and abundant closet space for excellent storage. Additional highlights include one assigned parking space, with heat, cooking gas and hot water covered in the HOA-enhancing both value and convenience. A laundry room with new washers and dryers is located just across the hall. The building also features a recently installed video intercom system and an on-site superintendent. Please note: no pets and no smoking permitted per Crosswinds Condominium Association by-laws.
